vectors.description: PUBLISH_DONE with INTERNAL_ERROR (0x0), stream_count=0, empty reason
PUBLISH_DONE with UNAUTHORIZED (0x1) and reason phrase

PUBLISH_DONE carrying status code 0x3, which draft-20 leaves unassigned. Draft-19 used it for SUBSCRIPTION_ENDED; draft-20 removed the code and the behaviour together, since Section 5.1.2 now says a publisher does not end a subscription solely because the Largest Object advances past the end of the Location Filter. Draft-20 Section 14 requires the receiver to accept it: "Receipt of an unknown error code in any error context (Session Termination, REQUEST_ERROR, PUBLISH_DONE, or Data Stream Reset) MUST be treated as equivalent to INTERNAL_ERROR for that context. An endpoint MUST NOT close the session because it received an unknown error code in a REQUEST_ERROR or PUBLISH_DONE." So the frame decodes; what a decoder must stop doing is mapping the code to a name. The same rule is in draft-19 verbatim, so this is not a revision change.
PUBLISH_DONE with UPDATE_FAILED (0x8) and reason phrase
PUBLISH_DONE with MALFORMED_TRACK (0x12) and reason phrase
PUBLISH_DONE with TRACK_ENDED (0x2) and stream_count=7. Draft-20 counts fill fetch streams (Section 5.1.3) toward Stream Count alongside subgroup streams, including streams that carried no Objects

PUBLISH_DONE whose Stream Count is the "unknown" sentinel. Draft-19 used 2^62 - 1; draft-20 changed it to 2^64 - 1, which MOQT's vi64 reaches in its nine-byte form (ff followed by eight ff bytes) because the encoding is not the QUIC varint and has no 2^62 ceiling. The sentinel is now indistinguishable from a well-formed exact count
